description: This file contains a repository class for managing assets in a backend system, including CRUD operations, related child entities, and validation checks. It interfaces with a PostgreSQL database via Npgsql, providing methods to create, retrieve, update, list, and soft-delete assets and their related data such as properties, status logs, and IDs.

classes.name: AssetRepository
classes.description: A sealed class providing CRUD and query operations for asset data, including related child tables, validations, and soft delete functionality.

classes.name: AssetRepository.EntityNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception thrown when a specified asset or related entity is not found during validation or retrieval.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new asset record in the database and returns its DTO.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an asset by ID, excluding soft-deleted records.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing asset record and returns the updated DTO.

methods.name: QueryAsync
methods.description: Queries assets based on optional filters, returns a list of matching DTOs.

methods.name: AssetExistsAsync
methods.description: Checks if an asset exists and is not soft-deleted.

methods.name: SoftDeleteAssetGraphAsync
methods.description: Performs a soft delete on an asset and all dependent related entities, ensuring referential integrity.

methods.name: InputParameterBelongsToAssetAsync
methods.description: Verifies whether a specific input parameter belongs to a given asset.

methods.name: ThroughputEquationBelongsToInputAsync
methods.description: Checks if a throughput equation is associated with a specific input parameter.

methods.name: GetLatestStatusToDateAsync
methods.description: Gets the most recent status to date for an asset, optionally excluding a specific log entry.

methods.name: CreateAssetStatusLogAsync
methods.description: Adds a new status log entry for an asset.

methods.name: ListAssetStatusLogsAsync
methods.description: Lists all status logs for an asset.

methods.name: GetAssetStatusLogByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific status log entry associated with an asset.

methods.name: UpdateAssetStatusLogAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing asset status log.

methods.name: CreateAdditionalAssetIdAsync
methods.description: Creates a new additional asset ID entry for an asset.

methods.name: ListAdditionalAssetIdsAsync
methods.description: Lists all additional IDs associated with an asset.

methods.name: GetAdditionalAssetIdByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific additional ID for an asset by ID.

methods.name: UpdateAdditionalAssetIdAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing additional asset ID record.

methods.name: CreateAssetPropertyAsync
methods.description: Creates a new asset property record.

methods.name: ListAssetPropertiesAsync
methods.description: Lists all properties associated with an asset.

methods.name: GetAssetPropertyByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific asset property by ID.

methods.name: UpdateAssetPropertyAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing asset property.

methods.name: CreateControlDeviceMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a new control device mapping under an asset.

methods.name: ListControlDeviceMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists control device mappings related to an asset.

methods.name: GetControlDeviceMappingByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific control device mapping by ID.

methods.name: UpdateControlDeviceMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing control device mapping.

methods.name: CreateInputParameterAsync
methods.description: Creates a new input parameter row.

methods.name: ListInputParametersAsync
methods.description: Lists input parameters for an asset.

methods.name: GetInputParameterByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific input parameter by ID.

methods.name: UpdateInputParameterAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing input parameter.

methods.name: CreateParentInputMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a parent input mapping for a child input parameter.
